invariants.rationale: The input list of records is expected to be non-null for processing.

A List's size is always non-negative in Java.
The method expects to process HoodieRecord objects, so elements should be non-null.
The method accesses record.getPartitionPath() for grouping, so partitionPath is expected non-null.
